statement: This sketch creates a dynamic field of interconnected geometric forms that continuously morph and shift in an autonomous loop. The visuals are driven by fluid, organic shapes that link together to form a cohesive whole, with abrupt color changes creating a sense of constant transformation. The system avoids gradual transitions, instead using sharp shifts between defined hues to emphasize the fluidity and motion of the composition. The entire scene evolves without any user input, creating an immersive spectacle that demonstrates emergent behavior through simple geometric interactions.
